name: wesapp
description: WESApp - Sistema de gestión para WES Security (monorepo)
author: WES Security

scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dev: sh -c 'cd backend && npm run dev & BACKEND_PID=$! && cd frontend && npm start; kill $BACKEND_PID'
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.format: cd backend && npm run format && cd ../frontend && npm run format
scripts.format:check: cd backend && npm run format:check && cd ../frontend && npm run format:check
scripts.test:all: NODE_ENV=test DB_NAME=wesapp_test npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run test:unit -- --runInBand
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run dead-code && npm run test:all && npm run build
